Using water for bladder washout risks electrolyte imbalance, so the answer is C. Water is hypotonic, so it can be absorbed through the bladder wall and cause water intoxication and hyponatraemia. The team note's claim that water is thicker than saline and leaks around the catheter is wrong, because water is not more viscous than saline, so I'm keeping C.
